messages:
Rina (CSM): Heads-up: Aerowave requested a midterm prorated credit and will submit a new PO via their channel partner. They said the procurement lead changed. Tagging finance/legal. @Lina @Mark :wave:

Omar (AM): Do they want the credit applied to the next invoice or to a past invoice? Also need to know if price tiers change with seat reduction.

Rina (CSM): They asked to apply against INV-2026-0450 (upcoming Mar invoice). No pricing change, just drop 5 seats. Channel partner email: partners@upbridge.io.

Lina (Finance): We need: 1) PO that references INV-2026-0450 or subscription id, 2) delegation from an on-file approver authorizing partners@upbridge.io to issue POs. Once docs are in, expect ~48h to process CM.

Mark (Legal): Delegation can be an email from a named approver on file or a letter on company letterhead. Because a partner is issuing the PO, please get explicit language "authorize Upbridge to issue POs for Aerowave for invoice INV-2026-0450". No contract amendment if pricing unchanged.

Rina (CSM): I'll send a single message with a PO template and a delegation email example. Want me to request CC to legal@aerowave.com?

Omar (AM): Yes, ask them to CC legal@aerowave.com. That speeds verification. Also include the prorate method: unused seat-days * per-seat rate post-discounts.

Rina (CSM): Sent to customer at 11:05 PT with templates. Included sample delegation: "I, <Name> (Title), authorize partners@upbridge.io to issue POs referencing INV-2026-0450."

receipt-bot: Attachment detected when customer replied (PO-UPB-3344.pdf). Saved to renewal docs.

Customer (via Rina): "Attached PO from Upbridge and a delegation email from our VP Finance (on file). Please confirm timeline."

Lina (Finance): Got both docs. Delegation email is from on-file VP Finance. I'll prepare credit memo CM-2026-199 and calculate prorate. Please confirm seat change: from 30 -> 25.

Rina (CSM): Confirmed seats 30 -> 25.

Lina (Finance): Draft CM ready. Calculation: 5 seats * $300/mo * prorate fraction (Mar 10 - Mar 31) = $... Net after 5% enterprise discount. I'll post final numbers and apply to INV-2026-0450 within 24h.

Mark (Legal): Delegation valid. No further review required.

Rina (CSM): Noting renewal risk: low (operational). Action items:
- Lina: apply CM (ETA 24h)
- Rina: confirm customer receipt and update case notes
- Omar: update renewal timeline in CRM to reflect seat change

Lina (Finance): Applied CM-2026-199 to INV-2026-0450. AR updated. Tagging thread as completed.

Rina (CSM): Thanks all 44d. Closing thread.
